hero.title: Fixtures that hold their numbers on the tenth tour.
hero.description: Beamvox designs and manufactures moving heads, washes, strobes and control for touring, theatre, broadcast and permanent installation. Every specification we publish comes from a measured unit.

positioning.title: A complete rig, from the head to the control surface.
positioning.description: Six platforms, one control language. Fixtures share connectors, protocols and service parts, so a rig assembled from the catalogue behaves as one system rather than a collection of purchases.

featured.title: Three that get specified most
featured.body: Full photometric data, DMX charts and service documentation for every model.

applications.title: Specified by the room, not by the brochure
applications.body: Different rooms punish different weaknesses. Each application page lists the fixtures we would put in front of that brief.

manufacturing.title: Four steps we do not skip
manufacturing.body: Manufacturing discipline is the only reason a fixture bought in year three still matches one bought in year one.

distribution.title: Sold through partners who know the territory.
distribution.description: We supply through distributors and resellers in Europe, the Americas and Africa. Stock is held regionally, so quotes are drawn from availability rather than a production schedule.

cta.title: Send us the plot, the room or the shortlist.
cta.description: Tell us what the rig has to do and we will come back with a fixture list, the measured data behind it and the distributor who can quote it.
